t: You're at Gay's The Word, an independent bookshop on Marchmont Street in Bloomsbury. It is the oldest LGBT bookshop in the United Kingdom. A small group from a gay socialist group called Gay Icebreakers founded it in 1979, and Peter Dorey was one of them, alongside Ernest Hole and Jonathan Cutbill. They were inspired by lesbian and gay bookstores in the United States. Camden Council was reluctant to grant a lease at first, and Ken Livingstone, then a local councillor, helped overcome that. For a period it was the only LGBT bookshop in England.
